description: This file defines HTTP client instrumentation utilities for Prometheus metrics, including middleware for tracking request in-flight, request count, duration, and tracing HTTP requests with hooks for various events.

classes.name: RoundTripperFunc
classes.description: A function type that implements the http.RoundTripper interface, allowing functions to be used as RoundTrippers.

classes.name: InstrumentTrace
classes.description: A struct holding hook functions for various httptrace.ClientTrace events, enabling custom instrumentation of HTTP request phases.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Method for RoundTripperFunc to implement the http.RoundTripper interface, calling the function itself.

methods.name: InstrumentRoundTripperInFlight
methods.description: Middleware that increments and decrements a Prometheus gauge to track in-flight requests.

methods.name: InstrumentRoundTripperCounter
methods.description: Middleware that observes request results with a Prometheus CounterVec, partitioned by HTTP status code and method.

methods.name: InstrumentRoundTripperDuration
methods.description: Middleware that measures request duration with a Prometheus ObserverVec, partitioned by HTTP status code and method.

methods.name: InstrumentRoundTripperTrace
methods.description: Middleware that reports timing of HTTP request phases to hook functions in an InstrumentTrace struct.
